zh-CN.title: 入门与交接指南
zh-CN.goal: 把散落资料变成可按步骤完成的工作指南。

optionalInputs.question: 读者的角色和已有基础是什么？
完成指南后应能独立做什么？
有哪些工具、资料和联系人？
是否有先后依赖、截止时间或常见卡点？

qualityChecks: 使用清楚的步骤和进度导航，桌面目录与手机折叠目录一致。
个人勾选默认只保存在本机，并明确说明；团队共建才选受控云端模式。
不将内部账号、访问密钥和未获授权的联系人信息放进成品。
zh-CN.missingInformationPolicy: 所有问题均可跳过；使用已有资料，显式列出影响结果的假设，未知事实保留待确认。

en.title: Onboarding guide
en.goal: Turn scattered material into a practical sequence people can follow.

optionalInputs.question: What is the reader’s role and starting knowledge?
What should they be able to do independently afterward?
Which tools, references and contacts are available?
Are there dependencies, deadlines or common blockers?

qualityChecks: Use ordered steps and consistent desktop/mobile progress navigation.
Personal checkmarks stay on the device by default; choose controlled cloud only for team participation.
Do not embed internal credentials or contact details without authorization.
en.missingInformationPolicy: All questions may be skipped. Use known material, state consequential assumptions, and leave unknown facts unresolved.
